package handler

import (
	"encoding/json"

	"GENRE_MODULE/game/rules"
)

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCoopView(room IGameRoomEntity, player IScenarioPlayerEntity) (rules.View, error) {
	var state rules.State
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(room.Dao().GetState()), &state); err != nil {
		return rules.View{}, err
	}
	for seat, id := range state.Members {
		if id == player.ID() {
			return rules.View{Revision: state.Revision, NextSeq: state.Last[id].Command.Seq + 1, Stage: state.Stage, Cleared: state.Cleared, Claimed: state.Claimed[seat], Coins: player.Dao().GetCoins()}, nil
		}
	}
	return rules.View{}, rules.ErrRule
}
